da: " .. coverPath)
            return false, "getcustomasset_unavailable"
        end

        local okAsset, resultAsset = pcall(function()
            return getcustomasset(coverPath)
        end)

        if not (okAsset and type(resultAsset) == "string") then
            warn("[YinYang Spotify] getcustomasset falló para la portada (" .. coverPath .. "): " .. tostring(resultAsset))
            return false, "getcustomasset_failed"
        end

        return true, resultAsset
    end

    local CoverAssetResolvedCache = {}

    resolveTrackCoverImage = function(track)
        if not track then
            return ""
        end

        if track.CoverURL and track.CoverURL ~= "" then
            local cacheKey = (track.CoverCacheName and track.CoverCacheName ~= "") and track.CoverCacheName or track.CoverURL
            local cached = CoverAssetResolvedCache[cacheKey]
            if cached then
                return cached
            end

            local okCover, coverAssetOrErr = ensureCoverCached(track)
            if okCover then
                CoverAssetResolvedCache[cacheKey] = coverAssetOrErr
                return coverAssetOrErr
            end
        end

        return track.Cover or ""
    end

    local function playTrack(index)
        local track = SpotifyState.Catalog[index]
        if not track then
            return
        end

        SpotifyState.SelectedIndex = index
        SpotifyState.CurrentTrack = track
        SpotifyState.CurrentTrackSeconds = durationToSeconds(track.Duration)
        SpotifyState.CurrentPausedPosition = 0
        SpotifyState.IsPlaying = true

        destroyAllSpotifySounds()
        destroyCurrentSound()

        updatePlayerFromTrack(track, index, "Descargando y reproduciendo...")
        syncPlaybackUI()

        local okCache, cachedAssetOrErr = ensureTrackCached(track)
        local soundAsset = okCache and cachedAssetOrErr or track.AudioURL

        local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
        sound.Name = "YY_Spotify_CurrentSound"
        sound.SoundId = soundAsset
        sound.Volume = SpotifyState.PlaybackVolume
        sound.PlaybackSpeed = SpotifyState.PlaybackSpeed
        sound.Looped = SpotifyState.IsRepeat
        sound.Parent = workspace

        SpotifyState.CurrentSound = sound

        SpotifyState.SoundProgressConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if SpotifyState.CurrentSound == sound then
                updateProgress(track, sound)
            end
        end)

        SpotifyState.SoundEndedConnection = sound.Ended:Connect(function()
            if SpotifyState.CurrentSound ~= sound then
                return
            end

            if SpotifyState.IsRepeat then
                task.spawn(function()
                    pcall(function()
                        sound.TimePosition = 0
                        sound:Play()
                        SpotifyState.IsPlaying = true
                        syncPlaybackUI()
                    end)
                end)
                return
            end

            local nextIndex = index + 1
            if nextIndex > #SpotifyState.Catalog then
                nextIndex = 1
            end
            if SpotifyState.FavoriteNeighbor then
                nextIndex = SpotifyState.FavoriteNeighbor(index, 1) or nextIndex
            end
            playTrack(nextIndex)
        end)

        pcall(function()
            sound:Play()
        end)

        SpotifyState.IsPlaying = true
        updatePlayerFromTrack(track, index, GetText("Reproduciendo", "Playing"))
        syncPlaybackUI()
    end

    local function selectTrack(index)
        local track = SpotifyState.Catalog[index]
        if not track then
            return
        end

        SpotifyState.SelectedIndex = index
        SpotifyState.CurrentTrack = track
        SpotifyState.IsPlaying = SpotifyState.CurrentSound ~= nil and SpotifyState.IsPlaying or false
        updatePlayerFromTrack(track, index, "Seleccionada: " .. track.Name)
        syncPlaybackUI()
    end

    local function toggleTrackLike(index)
        SpotifyState.CurrentLiked[index] = not isLiked(index)
        saveSpotifyFavorite(index)
        renderSongRows()
        syncPlaybackUI()
    end

    local function bindRowTap(guiObject, callback)
        if not guiObject then
            return
        end

        pcall(function()
            guiObject.Active = true
            guiObject.Selectable = false
        end)

        local lastFire = 0
        local function fireOnce()
            local now = os.clock()
            if now - lastFire < 0.35 then
                return
            end
            lastFire = now

            local ok, err = pcall(callback)
            if not ok then
                warn("[YinYang Spotify] Row tap failed: " .. tostring(err))
            end
        end

        if guiObject:IsA("GuiButton") then
            track(guiObject.Activated:Connect(fireOnce))
            track(guiObject.MouseButton1Click:Connect(fireOnce))
            track(guiObject.TouchTap:Connect(fireOnce))
            return
        end

        local activeInput = nil
        local startPosition = nil
        local moved = false
        local threshold = 14

        track(guiObject.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                activeInput = input
                startPosition = input.Position
                moved = false
            end
        end))

        track(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if activeInput and input == activeInput and startPosition then
                local delta = input.Position - startPosition
                if delta.Magnitude > threshold then
                    moved = true
                end
            end
        end))

        track(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if activeInput and input == activeInput then
                if not moved then
                    fireOnce()
                end
                activeInput = nil
                startPosition = nil
                moved = false
            end
        end))
    end

    local function applyPlaybackVolume(value)
        SpotifyState.PlaybackVolume = clamp(value, 0, 1)
        if SpotifyState.CurrentSound then pcall(function() SpotifyState.CurrentSound.Volume = SpotifyState.PlaybackVolume end) end
        refreshSpotifyPlaybackMenu(); refreshSpotifyFloatingPlayer()
    end
    local function applyPlaybackSpeed(value)
        SpotifyState.PlaybackSpeed = clamp(value, 0.50, 2)
        if SpotifyState.CurrentSound then pcall(function() SpotifyState.CurrentSound.PlaybackSpeed = SpotifyState.PlaybackSpeed end) end
        refreshSpotifyPlaybackMenu(); refreshSpotifyFloatingPlayer()
    end

        applyPlaybackVolume(math.floor(pct * 100 + 0.5) / 100)

        end

        if PM.dragInput and (input == PM.dragInput or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement) then

        end
    end))
    track(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if PM.dragInput and (input == PM.dragInput or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then
            PM.dragInput = nil
            PM.Body.ScrollingEnabled = true
            task.defer(function() SpotifyState.BlockSwipe = false end)
        end
    end))

        Parent = PM.TimerBox,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30),

        CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 0),
        SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
    })
    PM.timerLeft = function()
        if not SpotifyState.SleepAt then return nil end
        return math.max(0, SpotifyState.SleepAt - os.clock())
    end
    for i, minutes in ipairs(PM.TIMERS) do
        local text = minutes == 0 and "No" or (minutes >= 60 and "1 h" or (tostring(minutes) .. "m"))
        local chip = PM.chip(PM.TimerRow, text)
        chip.LayoutOrder = i
        PM.timerChips[i] = {Button = chip, Value = minutes}
        bindRowTap(chip, function()
            SpotifyState.SleepMinutes = minutes
            SpotifyState.SleepAt = minutes > 0 and (os.clock() + minutes * 60) or nil
            refreshSpotifyPlaybackMenu()
        end)
    end
    task.spawn(function()
        while PM.Panel.Parent do
            local left = PM.timerLeft()
            if left then
                if left <= 0 then
                    SpotifyState.SleepAt = nil
                    SpotifyState.SleepMinutes = 0
                    if SpotifyState.CurrentSound and SpotifyState.IsPlaying then
                        pcall(function()
                            SpotifyState.IsPlaying = false
                            SpotifyState.CurrentPausedPosition = math.max(0, tonumber(SpotifyState.CurrentSound.TimePosition) or 0)
                            SpotifyState.CurrentSound:Pause()
                        end)
                        PlayerMeta.Text = GetText("Pausado por el temporizador", "Paused by sleep timer")
                        syncPlaybackUI()
                    end
                end
                if PM.Panel.Visible then refreshSpotifyPlaybackMenu() end
            end
            task.wait(1)
        end
    end)

    local FloatingPlayer = nil
    local FP = {mini = false, lastCover = nil, rotation = 0}
    local function previousTrack()
        if #SpotifyState.Catalog == 0 then return end
        local index = SpotifyState.SelectedIndex - 1
        if index < 1 then index = #SpotifyState.Catalog end
        if SpotifyState.FavoriteNeighbor then
            index = SpotifyState.FavoriteNeighbor(SpotifyState.SelectedIndex, -1) or index
        end
        playTrack(index)
    end
    local function nextTrack()
        if #SpotifyState.Catalog == 0 then return end
        local index = SpotifyState.SelectedIndex + 1
        if index > #SpotifyState.Catalog then index = 1 end
        if SpotifyState.FavoriteNeighbor then
            index = SpotifyState.FavoriteNeighbor(SpotifyState.SelectedIndex, 1) or index
        end
        playTrack(index)
    end
    local function togglePlayback()
        if SpotifyState.CurrentSound then
            if SpotifyState.IsPlaying then
                SpotifyState.IsPlaying = false
                pcall(function()
                    SpotifyState.CurrentPausedPosition = math.max(0, tonumber(SpotifyState.CurrentSound.TimePosition) or 0)
                    SpotifyState.CurrentSound:Pause()
                end)
                PlayerMeta.Text = GetText("Reproducción pausada", "Playback paused")
            else
                SpotifyState.IsPlaying = true
                pcall(function()
                    if SpotifyState.CurrentPausedPosition and SpotifyState.CurrentPausedPosition > 0 then SpotifyState.CurrentSound.TimePosition = SpotifyState.CurrentPausedPosition end
                    SpotifyState.CurrentSound:Play()
                end)
                PlayerMeta.Text = GetText("Reproducción activa", "Playback active")
            end
            syncPlaybackUI()
        elseif SpotifyState.Catalog[SpotifyState.SelectedIndex] then
            playTrack(SpotifyState.SelectedIndex)
        end
    end
    -- La cabecera comparte el sonido de Spotify y conserva el campo de IDs al detenerlo.
    do

            Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 9, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, ZIndex = 15})
        B.bar = mk("Frame", {Parent = B.root, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(73, 32),

        corner(B.bar, 2)

            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 16})
        B.fill:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Accent")
        corner(B.fill, 2)
        local function button(name, right, image, callback)
            local b = mk("ImageButton", {Name = name, Parent = B.root,
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, right, 0.5, 0),
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(27, 27), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Image = asset(image), ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
                ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit, AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 16})
            b.Activated:Connect(callback)
            return b
        end
        B.previous = button("Previous", -91, 124844823753990, previousTrack)
        B.previous.Rotation = 180
        B.play = button("PlayPause", -62, 135609604299893, togglePlayback)
        B.next = button("Next", -33, 124844823753990, nextTrack)
        B.close = mk("TextButton", {Parent = B.root, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 27),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "×", TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220),
            Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 20, AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 16})
        B.close.Activated:Connect(function()
            destroyCurrentSound()
            SpotifyState.IsPlaying = false
            SpotifyState.CurrentTrack = nil
            SpotifyState.CurrentPausedPosition = 0
            syncPlaybackUI()
        end)
        function B.layout()
            if not B.active then return end
            -- AbsoluteSize ya incluye MainScale; convertir a unidades locales evita aplicar la escala dos veces.
            local parentScale = math.max(MainScale.Scale, 0.01)
            local width = math.clamp((TopBar.AbsoluteSize.X / parentScale) * 0.37, 180, 280)
            BoomboxPill.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, 30)
            BoomboxPill.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -width / 2, 0, 3)
            BannerFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -width / 2 - 6, 0, 18)
        end
        TopBar:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(B.layout)
        MainScale:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Scale"):Connect(B.layout)
        SpotifyState.RefreshBoombox = function()
            local sound = SpotifyState.CurrentSound
            local active = sound ~= nil and SpotifyState.CurrentTrack ~= nil
            if active ~= B.active then
                B.active = active
                B.root.Visible = active
                Boom.Disc.Visible = not active
                BoomboxInput.Visible = not active
                BoomboxPlaceholder.Visible = not active and BoomboxInput.Text == ""
                BannerFrame.Visible = not (Window._SpotifyAmbient and Window._SpotifyAmbient.Active)
                if active then
                    B.layout()
                else
                    BoomboxPill.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(155, 28)
                    BoomboxPill.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -77, 0.5, -18)
                    BannerFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -83, 0.5, 0)
                end
            end
            if not active then return end
            if B.title.Text ~= PlayerSongTitle.Text then B.title.Text = PlayerSongTitle.Text end
            if B.artist.Text ~= PlayerSongArtist.Text then B.artist.Text = PlayerSongArtist.Text end
            if B.cover.Image ~= AlbumArt.Image then B.cover.Image = AlbumArt.Image end
            B.play.Image = SpotifyState.IsPlaying and asset(74873705394436) or asset(135609604299893)
            local current = math.max(0, tonumber(sound.TimePosition) or 0)
            local duration = tonumber(sound.TimeLength) or 0
            if duration <= 0 then duration = durationToSeconds(SpotifyState.CurrentTrack.Duration) end
            B.time.Text = secondsToClock(current)
            B.total.Text = secondsToClock(duration)
            B.fill.Size = UDim2.new(duration > 0 and math.clamp(current / duration, 0, 1) or 0, 0, 1, 0)
        end
        SpotifyState.RefreshBoombox()
    end

    -- Barra compacta y navegación inspiradas en el reproductor móvil.
    -- Reutilizan el catálogo real y el mismo estado de reproducción.
    do
        local N = {lastProgress = -1}

        if Window._SpotifyAmbient then
            Window._SpotifyAmbient.LayoutPlayer = function(compact)
                N.openCatalog.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(compact and 72 or 12, 8)

            Window._SpotifyAmbient.LayoutPlayer(Window.CompactNavigation == true)

        N.openCatalog:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", "♫  Catálogo")
        N.openCatalog:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", "♫  Catalog")

        N.root = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = CatalogPage, Name = "SpotifyBottomNavigation",

        N.title = mk("TextLabel", {

        N.artist = mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent = N.mini, Size = UDim2.new(1, -100, 0, 16), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(51, 24),

            TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(205, 205, 210), TextSize = 10,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = 57,

        N.play = mk("ImageButton", {
            Parent = N.mini, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0.5, -1), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Image = asset(135609604299893), ImageColor3 = spotifyText, AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 59,
        })
        N.progress = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = N.mini, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 2), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -2),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 58,
        })
        N.mini.Activated:Connect(function() SpotifyPages:JumpTo(PlayerPage) end)
        N.play.Activated:Connect(togglePlayback)

        N.nav = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = N.root, Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 36), Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 53),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 56,
        })
        function N.button(index, iconName, fallback, es, en)
            local button = mk("TextButton", {
                Parent = N.nav, Size = UDim2.new(1/3, 0, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new((index-1)/3, 0, 0, 0),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 57,
            })
            local content = mk("Frame", {
                Parent = button, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 57,
            })
            mk("UIListLayout", {
                Parent = content, FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
                HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center, VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
                SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Padding = UDim.new(0, 4),
            })
            local glyph = mk("TextLabel", {
                Parent = content, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16), LayoutOrder = 1,
                BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = fallback, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
                TextColor3 = spotifyDim, TextSize = 15, ZIndex = 58,
            })
            local image = mk("ImageLabel", {
                Parent = content, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16), LayoutOrder = 1,
                BackgroundTransparency = 1, Image = "", ImageColor3 = spotifyDim,
                ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit, Visible = false, ZIndex = 58,
            })
            local label = mk("TextLabel", {
                Parent = content, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 20), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
                LayoutOrder = 2, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = GetText(es, en),
                Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextColor3 = spotifyDim, TextSize = 11, ZIndex = 58,
            })
            label:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", es)
            label:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", en)
            YinIcons.get(iconName, function(assetId)
                if image.Parent then
                    image.Image = assetId
                    image.Visible = true
                    glyph.Visible = false
                end
            end)
            return button, label, image, glyph
        end
        N.home, N.homeLabel, N.homeIcon, N.homeGlyph = N.button(1, "home", "⌂", "Inicio", "Home")
        N.search, N.searchLabel, N.searchIcon, N.searchGlyph = N.button(2, "search", "⌕", "Buscar", "Search")
        N.library, N.libraryLabel, N.libraryIcon, N.libraryGlyph = N.button(3, "music", "♫", "Mis canciones", "My songs")
        SpotifyState.RefreshCatalogNavigation = function()
            local homeColor = not SpotifyState.MySongsView and spotifyText or spotifyDim
            local libraryColor = SpotifyState.MySongsView and spotifyText or spotifyDim
            N.homeLabel.TextColor3, N.homeIcon.ImageColor3, N.homeGlyph.TextColor3 = homeColor, homeColor, homeColor
            N.searchLabel.TextColor3, N.searchIcon.ImageColor3, N.searchGlyph.TextColor3 = spotifyDim, spotifyDim, spotifyDim
            N.libraryLabel.TextColor3, N.libraryIcon.ImageColor3, N.libraryGlyph.TextColor3 = libraryColor, libraryColor, libraryColor
        end
        function N.openView(mySongs, focus)
            if FavPage.hide then FavPage.hide() end
            if UserSongForm.Visible then closeUserSongForm() end
            SpotifyState.FavoritesView = false
            SpotifyState.MySongsView = mySongs
            SongSearchBox.Text = ""
            SongList.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0)
            refreshSpotifyCatalogMode()
            if focus then pcall(function() SongSearchBox:CaptureFocus() end) end
        end
        N.home.Activated:Connect(function() N.openView(false, false) end)
        N.search.Activated:Connect(function() N.openView(false, true) end)
        N.library.Activated:Connect(function() N.openView(true, false) end)
        SpotifyState.RefreshMiniPlayer = function(progress)
            if N.title.Text ~= PlayerSongTitle.Text then N.title.Text = PlayerSongTitle.Text end
            if N.artist.Text ~= PlayerSongArtist.Text then N.artist.Text = PlayerSongArtist.Text end
            if N.cover.Image ~= AlbumArt.Image then N.cover.Image = AlbumArt.Image end
            local icon = SpotifyState.CurrentSound and SpotifyState.IsPlaying and asset(74873705394436) or asset(135609604299893)
            if N.play.Image ~= icon then N.play.Image = icon end
            if progress then
                local p = math.floor(math.clamp(progress, 0, 1) * 1000 + 0.5) / 1000
                if p ~= N.lastProgress then N.lastProgress = p N.progress.Size = UDim2.new(p, 0, 0, 2) end
            end
        end
        SpotifyState.RefreshMiniPlayer(0)
        SpotifyState.RefreshCatalogNavigation()
    end

    local function setFloatingVisible(visible)
        SpotifyState.FloatingPlayerVisible = visible == true
        if FloatingPlayer then FloatingPlayer.Visible = SpotifyState.FloatingPlayerVisible end
        refreshSpotifyPlaybackMenu(); refreshSpotifyFloatingPlayer()
    end

    FP.EXPANDED = Vector2.new(312, 112)
    FP.MINI = Vector2.new(48, 48)

    FP.iconButton = function(parent, image, size, iconSize, x, rotation)
        local button = mk("TextButton", {
            Parent = parent,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0, 0),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = "",
            AutoButtonColor = false,
            ZIndex = 526,
        })
        corner(button, 999)
        local icon = mk("ImageLabel", {
            Parent = button,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(iconSize, iconSize),
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Image = image,
            ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
            ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
            Rotation = rotation or 0,
            ZIndex = 527,
        })
        return button, icon
    end

    FP.applyMode = function()
        if not FloatingPlayer then return end
        local size = FP.mini and FP.MINI or FP.EXPANDED
        TweenService:Create(FloatingPlayer, TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size.X, size.Y)}):Play()
        FP.Corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, FP.mini and 24 or 18)
        FloatingPlayer.BackgroundTransparency = FP.mini and 1 or 0
        FP.Backdrop.Visible = not FP.mini
        FP.Shade.Visible = not FP.mini
        FP.Outline.Enabled = not FP.mini
        FP.Full.Visible = not FP.mini
        FP.Disc.Visible = FP.mini
        FP.Ring.Enabled = FP.mini
    end

    local function createFloatingPlayer()
        if FloatingPlayer and FloatingPlayer.Parent then return end
        FloatingPlayer = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = Window.ScreenGui,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(FP.EXPANDED.X, FP.EXPANDED.Y),
            Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -math.floor(FP.EXPANDED.X / 2), 1, -(FP.EXPANDED.Y + 24)),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(14, 14, 16),
            BackgroundTransparency = 0,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ClipsDescendants = true,
            Visible = SpotifyState.FloatingPlayerVisible,
            Active = true,
            ZIndex = 520,
        })
        FP.Corner = mk("UICorner", {Parent = FloatingPlayer, CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 18)})
        FP.Outline = stroke(FloatingPlayer, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), 1, 0.86)
        FP.Ring = mk("UIStroke", {Parent = FloatingPlayer, Color = spotifyGreen, Thickness = 2, Transparency = 0.05, Enabled = false})

        FP.Backdrop = mk("ImageLabel", {
            Parent = FloatingPlayer,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
            Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Image = "",
            ImageTransparency = 0.62,
            ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop,
            ZIndex = 521,
        })
        mk("UICorner", {Parent = FP.Backdrop, CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 18)})
        FP.Shade = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = FloatingPlayer,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ZIndex = 522,
        })
        mk("UICorner", {Parent = FP.Shade, CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 18)})
        mk("UIGradient", {
            Parent = FP.Shade,
            Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.2),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.5),
            }),
        })

        FP.Drag = mk("TextButton", {
            Parent = FloatingPlayer,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = "",
            AutoButtonColor = false,
            ZIndex = 523,
        })

        FP.Full = mk("Frame", {
            Parent = FloatingPlayer,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(FP.EXPANDED.X, FP.EXPANDED.Y),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            ZIndex = 524,
        })
        FP.Cover = mk("ImageLabel", {
